hero.selection: Variant 1 selected after direct image inspection: it is a bright, calm 5-by-2 modular shelf scene with a clear teal router/lens, separate host docks and a subtle amber side route; neither inspected variant contained visible letterforms, and variant 1 had the cleaner paper/ceramic editorial composition without the outdoor background of variant 2.
hero.prompt: Fresh, calm, premium editorial 3D isometric scene for an open-source skill library. Bright modular library made of ten distinct orderly shelves, each shelf holding abstract paper skill cards with no writing. A small teal router lens selects a few cards and sends them along clean glowing teal paths into separate host docking bays. Add one subtle amber optional side path, secondary and dashed in spirit. Use architectural clarity, generous negative space, soft studio light, tactile paper and ceramic surfaces, restrained geometry, and a sophisticated editorial product-illustration composition. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos, symbols, interface elements, labels, glyphs, or readable marks anywhere. Palette: paper #F7F9F5, ink #12231E, teal #137E73, optional amber #AC6415, with a soft neutral gray-green. Wide 16:9 composition, no typography.
hero.boundary: Illustrative product cover, not a runtime screenshot. Generation used the undocumented private Codex backend through gti; no account identifiers or credentials are included.

diagrams.write_scope: Each ephemeral Codex session was instructed to write only its named SVG path. The how-it-works and catalog-map sessions wrote their files before the local command timeout; the skill-lifecycle session exited 0. No other asset was edited by the SVG authoring runs.

Optional branches are dashed amber; the maintainer catalog-retirement lane is separate from local quarantine.
